name: Subdomain Scanner Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/15 * * * *" # Runs every 15 minutes automatically
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to click a button to run it manually

jobs:
  run-scanner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          
      - name: Run Harvester
        run: python harvester.py
        
      - name: Run Resolver
        run: python resolver.py
        
      - name: Run Validator
        run: python validator.py
        
      - name: Save Database
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add harvested.db
          git commit -m "Auto-update: Scanned DB" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push
